## Description

<!-- Please discuss the changes you have worked on. What do the changes do; why is this PR needed? -->

`restify` depends on some dependencies that are potentially out-of-maintenance (`string_decoder@1.3.0` is having low vulnerability). Due to resources, instead of migrating it from `restify` to `express`, we are archiving the sample instead.
